evidence: The interaction of the substrate surface with the precursor vapors was performed by successive pulses of vapors with permanent removal of the reaction products by pumping. The control over the temperature was carried out with the help of a thermocouple. Molecules of the precursors weakly bonded to the surface were moved away during pumping. In a typical cycle the inlet time of the precursors was fixed at 0.2 s. The purging time after supply was set at 1.0 s.
